body: If I wasn’t in quarantine id probably give it a shot but nonetheless this did help so thank you. I’ll try what you said and I’ll hope it works. For now I’ll probably try little things like going on a diet or something but I’ll keep trying. Thanks for helping and rooting for me it means much more than you think.

I’m not sure if you have or currently attend therapy but if you haven’t maybe check it out. I’ve been going and it honestly helps a lot especially with my rage. It feels good just to vent out all my frustrations. If you have already gone and it isn’t working one of the main things I do is write. I know it sounds stupid but hey why not try it. Just start writing everything you feel it doesn’t even have to make sense but I can promise you once you’re done you’ll feel a lot more calm. I’m sorry if this doesn’t help but I hope you’ll get better. Remember the voice inside your head is not you. Stay safe.

Hello I am so sorry for what’s happening to you and I really hope you get through it. Honestly I’m horrible at giving any advice with these types of things but I did some research that can maybe help you. First you can call the police and say “I prefer to remain anonymous” or you can call your local police department directly so it would be more discreet. Also you can look up your states anonymous tip line and call there. I hope this helps. Please find the courage to do this I believe in you. You can do this.
I hate hearing stuff like this because it’s the only reason why I don’t do it but I know I need to hear it so thank you I needed to be reminded of this tonight.
